I've drafted the baseline specification. Per our Spec-Driven Development workflow, **this is the first gate — please review the spec before we plan or build anything.**

## 📋 Specification ready for your review

- **Feature directory**: `specs/001-bookmark-manager/`
- **Spec file**: `specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`
- **Quality checklist**: all 16 items pass; no open clarifications

### What the spec proposes

**Core loop (MVP, P1)**
- **Save a bookmark** — paste a web address, optional custom title; auto-labels from the page title or the address itself
- **Browse & open** — see all saved bookmarks in a list, click to open the original page in a new tab

**Managing (P2)**
- **Edit & delete** — fix a title/address, or remove with a confirmation step

**Organizing (P3)**
- **Tags & search** — tag bookmarks, filter by tag, and keyword-search across title/address/tags

**Also covered**: validation of malformed addresses, duplicate-address warnings, empty/no-results states, best-effort page-title fetching, and most-recent-first ordering.

### Scope boundaries I assumed (please confirm or correct)

| Assumption | In v1? |
|---|---|
| Single local user — no accounts/login | ✅ in / others out |
| Web pages (HTTP/HTTPS) only | ✅ in |
| Local persistence (survives reload) | ✅ in |
| Cross-device sync / cloud backup | ❌ out |
| Import/export of existing browser bookmarks | ❌ out |
| Dedicated mobile layout | ❌ out (later) |

### A few questions worth settling now (optional — happy to proceed as-is)

1. **Tags & search (P3)** — keep in scope, or trim v1 to just save/browse/edit/delete?
2. **Auto page-title fetching** — worth the complexity, or start with manual titles only?
3. **Anything missing** — e.g. favicons, notes/descriptions, favorites/pinning, folders?

---

**How would you like to proceed?**
- ✅ **Approve as-is** → I'll move to the plan gate (`speckit-plan`)
- ✏️ **Request changes** → I'll revise the spec (`speckit-specify`) before planning

I'll hold here and won't start planning or coding until you approve.
